_README: Template for .claude/settings.local.json. Copy this file to .claude/settings.local.json and edit.
settings.local.json is gitignored and personal; this example file is checked into the repo as a starting point.
Permissions reduce harness approval prompts for tools the agent uses constantly.
Safety net: CLAUDE.md > Safety & Limits still applies on top of harness permissions.
Hard rules (no script execution, no auth flows, no writes outside sanctioned paths) cannot be overridden here.
- WebSearch: read-only, no domain to trust. Safe to allow globally.
- WebFetch(domain:...): pre-approved domains the explorer/ingestor subagents fetch from frequently.
Add the domains your topic relies on (canonical docs, reference sites, Wikipedia, etc.).
Anything not on this list will still prompt — that prompt has a 'always allow this domain' option,
which appends to settings.local.json automatically. Your trusted-domain list grows naturally over time.
If you set CLAUDE.md > Safety & Limits > Domain access > Allowlist to non-empty,
keep this WebFetch list aligned — the policy lives in CLAUDE.md, the prompts are silenced here.
